intent: Eight individual quality tasks teach height, width, thickness, depth, weight, spatial location and bounded ability or completion claims.
picturePurpose: Original paired complete flat brushes share overall height; bristle-head width is the contrast. Exact direct targets and evidence overlays stay coded. A bounded two-person counter uses the exact source requirement without inventing weight or completed lifting.

workshop.title: 看清宽窄，再核对句意
workshop.instruction: 选窄刷头；配上搬运人数，再核对位置和状态。

transfer.stem: Which account preserves the users, tear location and required lifters?
transfer.passage:
A morning at the community garden
A low wall surrounded the small garden. The wide path had room for walkers and cyclists, but our notes did not say that buses or trucks could use it. We chose a narrow brush to paint the edges of a sign. The choice was an instruction for our next job, not a report that the painting was finished.
Before starting, I tried to fasten my small coat buttons while wearing thick gloves. It was difficult, so I took the gloves off to do the buttons. At the craft table, a piece of thin paper tore along its fold. That was where it tore; it did not mean that it had torn before we folded it.
For lunch, we used a bowl that was deep enough for the soup. Later, we watched small fish gathering in shallow water near the garden. Finally, a heavy box needed two people to lift it. Two adults were getting ready to help; our notes did not record that the box had already been lifted.

options.text: The path has room for walkers and cyclists; the paper tore along its fold; the heavy box needs two people, with no completed lift recorded.
The path can take every truck and bus; the paper tore along its fold; the heavy box needs two people, with no completed lift recorded.
The path has room for walkers and cyclists; the paper tore before it was folded; the heavy box needs two people, with no completed lift recorded.
The path has room for walkers and cyclists; the paper tore along its fold; one person is enough to lift the heavy box.

answer.display: The path has room for walkers and cyclists; the paper tore along its fold; the heavy box needs two people, with no completed lift recorded.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对使用者、沿哪里撕裂，以及需要几人。

steps.text: 宽路容纳行人与骑车人；薄纸沿折痕裂开，不是折纸之前。
steps.reason: walkers and cyclists限定两类使用者；along its fold说位置，不是before的时间关系。

steps.text: 箱子需要两人；准备搬运不等于已经抬起。
steps.reason: needed two people保留人数；getting ready与had already been lifted不是同一状态。

distractors.reason: 把行人与骑车人扩大成所有卡车和公交。
把沿折痕的位置换成折纸前的时间。
把需要两人改成一人足够。

explanation.pitfall: 把使用范围扩大、把位置读成时间，或改掉人数和完成状态。

visual.title: 范围、位置和人数都保留
visual.caption: 每个细节都回到原文核对。
